dish.note: Cornmeal cakes griddled hot by the fire with butter and honey, the ones Meeko raids first.
dish.how: Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt, then stir in the milk, egg and half the melted butter to a thick batter. Fry spoonfuls in a hot buttered pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden. Serve hot with butter and honey.
dish.make_ahead: Mix the dry ingredients up to a day ahead; add the wet ones and cook to serve

steps.text: Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt, then whisk in the milk, egg and half the melted butter.
Fry spoonfuls in a hot buttered pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden.
Serve hot with butter and honey.
